items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. What was that thing that Spencer used to do, when they came up with no money at the end of the night, he'd say to the musicians, fellows, you can see for yourself! [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah.

ctx.x: When I got started in 1929, the bottom fell out of the stock market the month I got into it, in October, and the musicians were talking about how good times had been. And I would say, oh? And we starved to death on the road there for awhile, but we still worked. We starved, though, making a dollar and a half a night and then didn't get paid at all -- the promoter would run away with the money, or that was what the leader would always say. He'd blame it on the promoter.
Yeah. What was that thing that Spencer used to do, when they came up with no money at the end of the night, he'd say to the musicians, fellows, you can see for yourself!
